text:
Alex K.: Hey team :wave: I'm Alex (started today) — quick question on benefits: when's the deadline to enroll in medical/dental/vision? I checked the benefits portal but couldn't find my enrollment window.
HR Bot: Automated notice: New hire benefits enrollment window = 30 days from your start date. Enroll here: https://benefits.redwood.example/enroll — support@benefits.redwood.example for issues.
Sophia P.: Welcome Alex :tada: Confirming the bot — you have 30 days. If you're outside the US the plans differ (EU/UK) so DM me your country and I'll send the right packet.
Alex K.: Thanks! I'm US-based. Two quick follow-ups: 1) Are HSA and FSA options available immediately? 2) Is there anything special I need to do for payroll so benefits premiums start on first paycheck?
Emily R.: HSA and FSA are offered. HSA only if you pick the high-deductible medical plan. FSA has a separate opt-in. Both must be selected in the portal during the 30-day window.
Michael L.: Payroll note: payroll cutoff is the 15th of the month. If you start after cutoff, medical premiums may show on the next cycle. If you want us to check how it will appear on your paystub, send me your payroll ID (or full name + start date) and I'll confirm.
Alex K.: Also: are moving/relocation expenses reimbursable? I have receipts from my move from SF. If so, what's the submission flow?
Sophia P.: We do have a relocation reimbursement policy for new hires, but it depends on your offer. Please fill out the relocation form and attach receipts. Send to expenses@redwood.example. Required items: name, employee ID, date of move, expense list, receipts.
Sophia P.: Example (you can paste this into the body of an email or put in the form):

```
Name: Alex K.
Employee ID: (from offer letter)
Start date: 2026-03-23
Relocation expenses: movers ($X), travel ($Y), temporary housing ($Z)
Attachments: movers_receipt.pdf, flight_receipt.pdf
```

Sophia P.: After we receive it we route to People Ops + Finance for approval. Typical turnaround is 5–7 business days once complete docs received.
Alex K.: Great, thanks — one more: I-9 stuff — I had to upload docs during onboarding but do I need to bring anything on-site later?
HR Bot: I-9 reminder: If you completed remote verification, retain copies. If HR needs in-person verification we will ping you. For in-person: bring original documents (driver's license + SS card OR passport).
Alex K.: And holidays/floating days — how many do we get in year-one?
Sophia P.: Full-time employees: 10 company holidays + 2 floating days in year one (pro-rated based on start date). Contractors are prorated differently — ask your recruiter or PM.
Alex K.: Perfect, this helps a lot. Who should I DM if my benefits portal link errors out?
Sophia P.: DM me or open a ticket at support@benefits.redwood.example. If it's urgent ping @Sophia P. in this channel and I can escalate.
Alex K.: Thanks everyone :pray: :smile:
Michael L.: Welcome aboard Alex — ping me if you want me to check payroll timing.
Sophia P.: Welcome again :confetti_ball: If you want, I can schedule a 15-min benefits walkthrough this week.
Alex K.: That'd be awesome, thanks!
